integration_scope: Shared application policy dispatch, persistent exact owner grants, evidence-grounding repairs and qualification
source_commit_resolution: Build receipt binds final commit and all payload files; this source metadata does not assert approval, signature or activation.
exclusion_reason: Unchanged host-specific legacy scripts remain only in trusted signed baseline runtime.
acceptance_limits: Grants cover only research/public and project/tests; signed host/OS/provider authority remains independent.
Same-OS-account full authority rollback before restart is outside the host-local continuity guarantee.
Real model qualification is a limited sample with retained failures, not model promotion.
Human acoustic acceptance, physical removal/reinsertion and second-host checks remain separate.
